identity_arcface.error: No faces detected in any output frame

landmark_nme.note: Lower NME = better expression/pose transfer. Normalised by inter-ocular distance.

temporal_lpips.note: Lower = more temporally stable. p95 captures worst flickering.

fid.note: Lower FID = more realistic. Computed on InceptionV3 pool3 face crop features.

latency.note: Latency must be measured by instrumenting the generation model directly. See metric_latency() docstring for measurement instructions.
